neighbours.label: the word introducing what a change depends on, after a change verb ('varies depending on', 'changes based on')
fire: The price of a ticket can vary depending on the day you travel.
Cooking time will change based on the size of the chicken.
The dose is adjusted depending on the weight of the patient.
Your monthly bill may rise or fall based on how much water you use.
Symptoms tend to differ depending on the age of the child.
The colour of the leaves shifts depending on how much sun they get.
Fees are calculated based on the number of students enrolled.
The route can change depending on the weather in the mountains.
quiet: The price of a ticket can vary a lot, so check before you travel.
Cooking time will change, so keep checking the chicken.
The dose is adjusted by the nurse every morning for the patient.
Your monthly bill may rise or fall, and nobody explains why.
Symptoms tend to differ a great deal from one child to another.
The colour of the leaves shifts slowly through the autumn months.
Fees are calculated by the office at the start of each term.
The route can change at short notice in the mountains.

notes: Card top: 'can change based on', 'doubled after', 'easier depending on', 'change depending on'. Near misses keep the change verb but drop the conditioning phrase.
